title: Lior and the Letter
author: Quentin Okonkwo
blurb: Freya Nakamura, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the statute expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
